req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-018 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI documentation with an HTTP 2xx response. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — exact status code 200 (not 201, not 199) and exact Content-Type header containing 'text/html'; (4) DT — response body contains specific Swagger UI identifiers ('swagger-ui', 'openapi') confirming it is not a generic 200 page. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions catch status-code constant mutations; exact string presence assertions catch body-content mutations; method-not-allowed test catches route-registration mutations.

tests.name: test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html
preconditions: GET /docs endpoint is registered by FastAPI automatically
trace: R-PLAYER-018: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'text/html' in response.headers.get('content-type', '')
    body = response.text
    assert 'swagger-ui' in body.lower()

test_get_docs_returns_200_with_swagger_html()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_docs_response_body_is_non_empty():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/docs')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert len(body) > 0
    body_lower = body.lower()
    assert '<html' in body_lower or '<!doctype' in body_lower
